mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions, supporting corporate profit growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or correlation between UNRATE < 4.0% and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or joint signal Rank IC falls below 0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized), a decline in federal funds rate signals central bank easing to prevent economic contraction, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC for signal in this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior quarter signals strong employment growth, supporting consumer spending and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or correlation between PAYEMS growth and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or joint signal Rank IC falls below 0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annualized), a decline in real GDP level signals economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 declines and regime condition holds, or Rank IC for signal in this regime is below 0.02.
